title: Rational Immunogenicity Modulation of Virus-Like Particles by VLPIM.
authors: Wang, Chufan; Chen, Yeyun; Wang, Ming-Wei; Ren, Lei; Zhou, Qingtong
one_liner_zh: 该文提出VLPIM计算框架，整合AI蛋白设计、结构预测和免疫原性预测工具，对病毒样颗粒进行理性免疫调节，虽对象为VLP多聚体而非单体蛋白，但其结构-序列优化和虚拟筛选流程可迁移至蛋白质结构计算设计，具有方法学启发。
abstract: Virus-like particles (VLPs) are versatile platforms for drug delivery and vaccine development, but precisely customizing their immune profiles for specific clinical applications remains challenging. Here, we present a computational framework that integrates complementary artificial-intelligence-driven tools for protein design, structure prediction, and antigenicity assessment to enable rational immunogenicity modulation of VLPs while preserving their structural integrity. Leveraging the central role of CD4(+) T cells in adaptive immunity, this framework first combines class II major histocompatibility complex (MHC-II)-restricted epitope prediction with structure-guided sequence optimization to generate a focused mutation library. Subsequently, its virtual screening workflow combines immunogenicity predictions and structural modeling to pinpoint variants likely to attenuate or enhance CD4(+) T cell activation while preserving VLP integrity. This framework enables a broader and more efficient exploration of the mutation space to identify VLP structural variants with tailored immunogenicity profiles; hence, we term it the VLPIM (Virus-Like Particle Immunogenicity Modulation) platform. Using hepatitis B core VLPs as proof of concept, VLPIM generated a mutation library of 120 variants, computationally filtered down to 4 candidates, and ultimately identified 2 variants that retained native virus-like morphology, as confirmed by transmission electron microscopy. In vitro immunogenicity assays confirmed that epitope substitutions could either suppress or enhance CD4(+) T cell activation. This generalizable pipeline permits precise immunogenicity modulation of VLPs and other multimers, accelerating their development as targeted drug carriers and next-generation vaccine platforms. VLPIM is available as both a locally executable tool on GitHub (https://github.com/RuijinHospitalVNAR/VLPIM) and an online web server (https://ruijinhospitalvnar.github.io/Toolboxes/VLPIM_Web_services/).
abstract_zh: 病毒样颗粒（VLPs）是多功能平台，用于药物递送和疫苗开发，但精确定制其免疫特征以适用于特定临床应用仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出一个计算框架，整合了互补的人工智能驱动工具，用于蛋白质设计、结构预测和抗原性评估，以实现对VLPs的合理免疫原性调节，同时保持其结构完整性。利用CD4(+) T细胞在适应性免疫中的核心作用，该框架首先将II类主要组织相容性复合体（MHC-II）限制性表位预测与结构引导的序列优化相结合，生成聚焦突变文库。随后，其虚拟筛选流程结合免疫原性预测和结构建模，以识别可能减弱或增强CD4(+) T细胞激活同时保持VLP完整性的变体。该框架能够更广泛且高效地探索突变空间，以识别具有定制免疫原性特征的VLP结构变体；因此，我们将其命名为VLPIM（病毒样颗粒免疫原性调节）平台。使用乙型肝炎核心VLPs作为概念验证，VLPIM生成了包含120个变体的突变文库，经计算筛选至4个候选，最终鉴定出2个保留天然病毒样形态的变体，并通过透射电子显微镜确认。体外免疫原性测定证实，表位替换可抑制或增强CD4(+) T细胞激活。这一通用流程允许对VLPs及其他多聚体进行精确免疫原性调节，加速其作为靶向药物载体和下一代疫苗平台的开发。VLPIM可作为本地可执行工具在GitHub（https://github.com/RuijinHospitalVNAR/VLPIM）和在线网络服务器（https://ruijinhospitalvnar.github.io/Toolboxes/VLPIM_Web_services/）上获取。
